summary: Each extension build now gets a persistent 512M npm cache volume. Before each build, `trim_cache` empties it when less than a quarter is free; it removes symlinks without following them, and `rmtree` cannot be redirected by links. The timeout budget is now stop 40 s + exec 180 s (build killed at 150 s) + start 60 s (readiness waits up to 30 s) = 280 s, under the 300 s upstream fetch header timeout. That resolves F1, and `trim_cache` resolves F2. The temp tests check the cache mount, the trim threshold on both sides, safe handling of symlinks, the 5 s readiness probe within the 30 s window, and the new build timeouts; all pass and every changed executable line is covered.
